messages.subject: collapse and geom_tiplab
parts:
I am sorry, I failed to make a repeatable example, but if i use collapse and geom_tiplab together, I always get a number next to the collapsed clade which represents the collapsed number of tips. Can I get rid of that somehow?
If i try to make a reproduicble example like this:

tree <- rtree(50)
q1 <- ggtree(tree) + geom_tiplab() 
q2 <- collapse(q1, 55)

it never happens. No numbers at the tip. And I don't know where it is coming from. What can I do?

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: collapse and geom_tiplab
parts:
I intended to to that, since when you collapse a clade, it turn out to be a tip when visualizing it.

Currently you can use:

q1 <- ggtree(tr) + geom_tiplab(aes(subset=(node != 55)))
collapse(q1, 55)

I will disable labeling the collapsed node as tip in future release, then you don't need to do the subset mapping.
